seo_title: Private Food Tours Malaysia | Simply Enak
seo_description: Book a private food tour in Malaysia with Simply Enak. Your group only, your pace, your guide.
hero_subtitle: Your group, your pace, your guide — from just two people to a corporate team.
hero_image_alt: Private food tour group in Kuala Lumpur (placeholder)
comparison_heading: Which one is right for you?
testimonials_eyebrow: What guests say about going private
testimonials_intro: Most guests who book a private tour tell us afterwards they wish they'd done it from the start. Here's what a few recent groups said.
tailored_example_heading: A conference full of fisheries researchers wanted to eat what they study
tailored_example_body:
The 21st International Fisheries Economics & Trade Conference brought researchers from 40 countries to Georgetown. A group of attendees reached out: they'd spent three days in conference rooms talking about aquatic food systems and wanted to actually handle one.

We took them to the wet market first thing in the morning — not to eat, but to shop. They moved through the fish stalls with the focused attention of people who understood exactly what they were looking at: threadfin, grouper, stingray. They bought for the whole group.

Then we drove inland to Balik Pulau. The tourists don't come this way. We visited a working belacan factory — fermented shrimp paste, the base of most Malaysian cooking — and the smell alone was worth the drive. A local restaurant cooked the fish they'd bought that morning. After lunch we walked a quiet fishing harbour before driving back to Georgetown.

The tour existed because they asked for it. We'd never run it before.
tailored_example_image_alt: Penang wet market — IIFET 2024 tailored tour (placeholder)
tour_types_intro: Depending on what you're after, we can go one of two ways.
private_type_description: You choose one of our tours — the same stalls, the same commentary, the same guide — but the whole thing runs just for your group. No other guests, no compromises on pace, no waiting around. If someone in your group can't eat something, we sort it out with your guide before the day. That's it.
tailored_type_description: We start from scratch. You tell us who you are, what you want to eat, how long you want to walk, and what you'd love to take home from the day. We design a route around that — new stalls, cooking demonstrations, market visits, a sit-down meal, whatever makes sense for your group. Tailored tours suit celebrations, return visitors, and corporate groups who want something nobody else has done.
why_subtitle: You book the guide. You get the guide. No strangers, no compromises.

why_private.title: Your guide, your group
why_private.detail: No other guests on your tour. Your guide's full attention stays on your group all day — adjusting pace, answering questions, staying as long as you want at a stall.

why_private.title: Your schedule
why_private.detail: We set start times around you. Morning, late morning, evening — whatever works, and you're not waiting on strangers or cutting a stall short because someone else is tired.

why_private.title: Your interests
why_private.detail: Dietary needs, languages, how much you want to walk — we work all of this out with your guide before the day, not on it. Nothing is an afterthought.

configurator_body: Tell us who you are and what matters — we'll sketch a route and refine it on WhatsApp.

audiences.label: Families
audiences.detail: Set a pace the kids can handle. Stop when you need to. We've run private tours with children as young as four and adapted the route and commentary to match.

audiences.label: Couples
audiences.detail: No schedule pressure, no waiting for a group. A private tour is one of the more memorable ways to spend a day somewhere new — unhurried and genuinely yours.

audiences.label: Corporate groups
audiences.detail: Team meals and client visits that don't feel like team meals. We take groups to the stalls where Kuala Lumpur actually eats — not the restaurants on the tourist strip.

audiences.label: Special occasions
audiences.detail: Birthdays, anniversaries, farewell trips. We've marked all of them. Tell us what the occasion is and we'll shape the day around it.

pricing_heading: Pricing depends on group size and tour
pricing_body: Private tours are priced per group, not per head — so the more of you there are, the less each person pays. Send us your dates and group size and we'll come back with a quote within a few hours.
available_privately_subtext: Choose the tour that fits your group, then tell us you'd like it private.
corporate_callout: For corporate groups: We also take work groups and corporate visitors to the stalls locals eat at.

faqs.name: Is a private tour worth the extra cost?
faqs.answer: That depends on what you're after. If you want to move at your own pace, have the guide's full attention, and not worry about anyone else's dietary needs or energy levels — then yes, it's worth it. Most guests who book a private tour tell us afterwards they wish they'd done it from the start. If you're happy meeting other travellers and sharing the experience, a join-in tour gives you the same stalls and the same guides for less.

faqs.name: What's the minimum group size?
faqs.answer: Two people is fine — we've done it plenty of times. Most private groups run between 4 and 8. If there are two of you, you'll split the full tour rate between you rather than across a larger group, so it works out to more per head. Still worth it for a lot of couples.

faqs.name: Can we change the route?
faqs.answer: Once you book, your guide will reach out on WhatsApp before the day to go through the plan. If you'd like to add a stop, skip one, or linger somewhere longer, that's the time to say so. On the day itself we can adjust too — if you're loving a stall and want to stay, we stay.

faqs.name: How far ahead should we book?
faqs.answer: A week ahead is comfortable, two is better. We've pulled tours together in 48 hours when we had to, but it gives your guide more time to prepare and brief the stalls. For groups of 8 or more, three weeks is ideal.

faqs.name: Can you handle dietary restrictions?
faqs.answer: That's one of the main reasons people go private. On a join-in tour we work around dietary needs on the day — on a private tour, we brief your guide and the stalls in advance so nothing is a surprise or an afterthought. Vegetarian, halal, allergies, strong dislikes — tell us when you enquire.

faqs.answer: Je kunt een privétour boeken vanaf 2 personen. De meeste privégroepen variëren van 4 tot 12 gasten.

faqs.name: Kunnen we de route aanpassen?
faqs.answer: Ja! Privétours inclusief een planningsgesprek vooraf met je gids. Je kunt de route aanpassen, stops toevoegen of weglaten, en het tempo afstemmen op de interesses van je groep.

faqs.name: Hoe ver van tevoren moeten we boeken?
faqs.answer: We raden aan om minstens 1-2 weken op voorhand te boeken voor privétours. Voor groepen van 8+ boek je best 3-4 weken op voorhand.

faqs.name: Bieden jullie groepskorting?
faqs.answer: Groepen van 6 of meer krijgen meestal een lager tarief per persoon. Laat ons weten met hoeveel jullie zijn en we maken een offerte op maat.

faqs.name: Kunnen jullie rekening houden met dieetwensen?
faqs.answer: Absoluut. Privétours zijn perfect voor dieetwensen. We licht alle verkopers vooraf in en passen de route aan zodat iedereen bij elke stop goed eet.

faqs.name: Какой минимальный размер группы для частного тура?
faqs.answer: Частный тур можно заказать даже для 2 человек. Обычно группы состоят из 4-12 гостей.

faqs.name: Можно ли изменить маршрут?
faqs.answer: Да! Частные туры включают предварительную встречу с вашим гидом. Вы можете изменить маршрут, добавить или убрать остановки и подстроить темп под интересы вашей группы.

faqs.name: За сколько лучше бронировать тур?
faqs.answer: Частные туры рекомендуем бронировать за 1-2 недели. Для групп от 8 человек бронируйте за 3-4 недели.

faqs.name: У вас есть скидки для групп?
faqs.answer: Для групп от 6 человек цена на одного обычно ниже. Напишите нам, укажите размер группы, и мы подготовим индивидуальное предложение.

faqs.name: Можно ли учесть особенности питания?
faqs.answer: Конечно. Частные туры идеально для этого подходят. Мы заранее предупреждаем всех продавцов и подстраиваем маршрут так, чтобы каждому было вкусно на каждой остановке.

faqs.name: プライベートツアーの最小グループ人数は？
faqs.answer: 2名様からプライベートツアーを予約できます。ほとんどのグループは4〜12名様です。

faqs.name: ルートはカスタマイズできますか？
faqs.answer: はい！プライベートツアーには、ガイドとの事前プランニングコールが含まれています。ルートのカスタマイズ、ストップの追加・削除、グループの興味に合わせたペース調整が可能です。

faqs.name: 予約はどのくらい前にすればいいですか？
faqs.answer: プライベートツアーは、1〜2週間前までの予約がおすすめです。8名以上のグループは、3〜4週間前までにお願いします。

faqs.name: グループ割引はありますか？
faqs.answer: 6名以上のグループはお一人あたりの料金が安くなります。人数を教えてくれれば、見積りを出します。

faqs.name: 食事制限に対応できますか？
faqs.answer: もちろんです。プライベートツアーは食事制限のニーズにぴったりです。事前にすべてのベンダーに伝え、ルートのカスタマイズもできるので、みんなが各ストップでしっかり食べられますよ。

faqs.name: Qual é o tamanho mínimo de grupo para um tour privado?
faqs.answer: Pode reservar um tour privado a partir de 2 pessoas. A maioria dos grupos privados varia entre 4-12 convidados.

faqs.name: Podemos personalizar o roteiro?
faqs.answer: Sim! Os tours privados incluem uma chamada de planeamento com o seu guia antes do tour. Pode personalizar o roteiro, adicionar ou remover paragens e ajustar o ritmo aos interesses do seu grupo.

faqs.name: Com que antecedência devemos reservar?
faqs.answer: Recomendamos reservar com pelo menos 1-2 semanas de antecedência para tours privados. Para grupos de 8+, reserve com 3-4 semanas de antecedência.

faqs.name: Vocês oferecem desconto para grupos?
faqs.answer: Grupos de 6 ou mais pessoas geralmente pagam menos por pessoa. Entre em contato com o tamanho do seu grupo e preparamos um orçamento personalizado.

faqs.name: Conseguem acomodar restrições alimentares?
faqs.answer: Claro. Os tours privados são perfeitos para necessidades alimentares. Informamos todos os fornecedores com antecedência e podemos personalizar o roteiro para que todos comam bem em cada paragem.
